payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test's own held-map helper (`_held_from_own_name`) only mapped a clause's name when that name's own span count was exactly one, so a held name that opens two constructs never reached `rewrite_moved_citations`'s own `len(spans) == 1` check at all. I changed the helper to map every clause that names exactly one name, regardless of how many constructs that name opens, matching the criterion's own wording ('every offset whose clause names one, mapped to that name'). This lets the `twin` defect (two constructs) actually reach the production check, and I confirmed the mutation (`== 1` to `>= 1`) now fails the test, then reverted the mutation.
